contents: **Lookup precedence is determined by scope, namespace, and path form.** Lexical ribs take priority only for an unqualified one-segment name; module lookup then follows the applicable Rust namespace, imports, ancestry, prelude, and external-module rules rather than combining every visible name into an unordered global set. Leaving a lexical scope restores enclosing bindings; later bindings retain their own body-local identity and type even when nested or sibling scopes have allocated other locals.
